entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?

Thank you. Let me pull that up... I see the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 15th. That was 24 days ago. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
There is no issue. I just don't need it anymore. There was a family emergency.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I hope everything is alright. Can you tell me a little more about what happened? It helps us document the reason for the return request.
My husband was in the hospital. He had to have emergency surgery.
Oh, that's terrible. I'm so sorry. I can only imagine how stressful that must have been.
This was supposed to be a gift for his military deployment, which is now obviously not happening. We just weren't thinking about return windows.
Of course, that's completely understandable. Thank you for sharing that with me. Please give me one moment to review our return policy for you.
Okay, I have good news. It looks like you don't even need a special exception. My system shows that VeloFit items are eligible for return within 10 days of delivery.
Right. So I just explained all that for nothing. Fine.

My apologies, ma'am, I just needed to be thorough. Since you're only on day 24, you are well within the window. I've gone ahead and approved this return for a full refund. I'm emailing the prepaid shipping label to you right now.
Whatever. As long as it's handled.
It is. Once our warehouse receives the item, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and I sincerely hope your husband has a speedy recovery. Have a good day.
